stationId.description: Station identifier used by the selected provider

updatesEvery.description: Seconds between updates; values below 30 are clamped

maxStaleMinutes.description: Minutes to keep the last successful departures after an error

maxDepartures.description: Maximum number of departures to display

animationSpeed.description: DOM update animation duration in milliseconds

showLastUpdate.description: Show the last update time in the module footer

mode.description: Display clock time, relative time, or relative time below a threshold

thresholdMinutes.description: Threshold in minutes for relative-under mode

showPlannedTime.description: Show scheduled instead of expected time in absolute mode

showRealtimeIndicator.description: Visually mark departures with real-time data

columnOrder.description: Order and visibility of departure table columns

timeToStation.description: Walking time to the station in minutes

maxUnreachableDepartures.description: Maximum unreachable departures to keep; null removes this limit

excludeCanceled.description: Exclude canceled departures from the display

fetchRetries.description: Retry attempts after the initial request

lineFilter.description: Only include matching lines; a comma-separated string is also accepted

directionFilter.description: Only include matching directions; a comma-separated string is also accepted

productFilter.description: Only include matching products; a comma-separated string is also accepted

replaceInLineNames.description: Text replacements applied to line names

lineStylePreset.description: Preset used to style public transport line badges

contact.description: Contact for Transitous requests, such as an email or forum alias

apiKey.description: API key required by the PLK provider

clientVersion.description: Optional client version sent to provider clients

hafasProfile.description: HAFAS profile, for example insa or vbb

vendoProfile.description: Vendo profile, for example db, dbnav, or dbris

timeInFutureMinutes.description: Look-ahead window for provider queries in minutes

includeRelatedStations.description: Include nearby or related stations when supported

delayThresholdMinutes.description: Minimum delay in minutes that triggers an alert

includeNoDepartures.description: Send an alert when no reachable departures remain
